name: topical-guardrailing-nemo-benchmarking-old
description: Benchmark for evaluating topical guardrails and content-control behavior of language models: whether models refuse, redirect, or comply appropriately with prompts on restricted or sensitive topics. Measures both binary correctness of guardrail enforcement and quality of allowed outputs when topics are permitted.
evaluation_method: accuracy (guardrail enforcement) and human_eval for response quality
reputation: A task-focused benchmark used by practitioners testing guardrail behavior in NeMo/onepaneai workflows; relatively niche and used for internal tooling and research.
